caption: The drawing features a central human figure sitting on the ground, playing a stringed instrument resembling a guitar. The person has light-colored skin, wears a red jacket, black hat, and black shoes, and their legs are stretched out in front of them. Surrounding this figure are stylized, tall plants with long black stems and round berries or buds colored in shades of pink and red. The background consists of a mix of brown and blue with the area behind the person primarily blue, giving a sense of an open space or sky. There is a large, dark purple circular shape with a keyhole in its center positioned above the person's head. In the upper corners, there are red, blue, and white ornamental designs resembling draped fabric or banners. The border of the scene is irregular and brown with touches of blue in the corner elements. The entire drawing is set against a plain white background.
title: Small Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
